newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day Cetes rates end 60 basis points up.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day Cetes rates end 60 basis points up.

text.p: Mexico's same-day Cetes rates rose 60 basis points higher to close at 23.10 percent, pressured by the expectation of an increase in primary interest rates at the Cetes auction, dealers said.
"Up until yesterday, people were still thinking rates could drop slightly, but the movements of the U.S. 30-year bond changed expectations," said one dealer.
The yield on the 30-year bond was 6.97 percent on Tuesday.
A survey by Reuters of 12 money market dealers showed expectations for an increase of about 20 basis points in the one-month Cetes rate to 24.53 percent at the auction.
Bank notes and acceptances, including pagares, rose 15 basis points to 24.80 percent.
Dealers said that the rates at which the central bank injected liquidity in the secondary market gave a clear indication that primary rates will rise.
Banco de Mexico assigned credits at 26.13 percent, 26.08 percent and 25.62 percent.
Maturing credits on Wednesday are seen between 4.0 and 4.5 billion pesos.
